⚠️ Failure Symptom & Factory Service Manual Root Cause

Symptom on machine: You press Start, the top lid lock clicks 3 times, the red Lid Locked LED flashes continuously, and the washer refuses to agitate or enter the spin cycle.

Verified technical root cause: Broken solenoid coil or corroded contact inside the top-deck lid lock latch assembly (WH01X27954).

🔧 Step-by-Step DIY Inspection & Replacement Checklist

  1. Check the plastic lid strike tab on the underside of the lid first to make sure it isn't snapped off.
  2. If the plastic strike is intact and the lock clicks 3 times and gives up, remove the two 1/4-inch screws on the back of the control console, lift the top deck slightly, and snap in the new WH01X27954 lid lock switch.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (Lid Lock Clicking 3 Times / Won't Spin or Start)

Is WH08X32697 compatible with WH01X27954?
Yes! WH08X32697 is GE's latest kit that includes the WH01X27954 switch plus the updated bezel and strike.
